scope: abstract records, artificial scalar arrays and adapter metadata only; no engine, domain labels, model fitting or pilot generation

zero_observed_coverage_with_passed_true.interpretation: The gate does not bind or recompute a coverage acceptance criterion. Acceptance is a shape/declaration result, not demonstrated statistical adequacy.

same_content_claimed_calibration_and_hol.interpretation: Conflicting uses of the same content identity are not cross-checked; no distinct subset-membership identity is recorded.

adapter_cross_archive_identity.interpretation: Vocabulary equality is enforced, but actual archive identity is not verified by this adapter.

adapter_task_order_mismatch.interpretation: Task-record position is used as the tensor-axis index even though the declared vocabulary provides a separate name order.

label_availability_vs_weight_availabilit.reason: Train contains no available labels for this task.
label_availability_vs_weight_availabilit.interpretation: Label availability and applicability of design weights share one filtered denominator and one no-label reason.

boundary: These reproduce API consistency gaps only; outer archive admission and actual research use were not exercised. No acceptance thresholds or domain calibration choices are proposed.
